reviews.paraphrase: Identify the failure that would outweigh staff-time savings and trigger stopping the limited scheduling pilot.
reviews.naturalAnswer: A schedule that leaves a client without a safe journey would make me stop the pilot, even if it saves staff time.

reviews.paraphrase: Set the number of unsafe journeys in 1,000 scheduled journeys that would stop the rollout.
reviews.naturalAnswer: Two unsafe journeys out of 1,000 scheduled journeys would stop the rollout.

reviews.paraphrase: Set the minimum number of vulnerable clients in every 100 who must keep the same carer before expansion.
reviews.naturalAnswer: At least 90 of every 100 vulnerable clients must keep the same carer before we expand.

reviews.paraphrase: Choose which stated benefit repeat clients most often gave for hiring Lumen again.
Say whether any client has agreed to buy the monthly product without a senior researcher present.
Set the minimum number of clients who must pay for the new service a second time before half the team moves to it.
reviews.naturalAnswer: At least five clients must pay for the new service again before we move half the team.

reviews.paraphrase: Decide whether the planners' roles should still change if the same planners meet the target with accurate information and fair targets.
Decide whether one plant must meet its delivery target with the same planners before all six plants receive funding.
Choose who has final authority when an AI plan risks making a customer late.
Choose the fan group whose ticket purchases must increase before allocating GBP 18 million.
Choose whether new viewers should first see one character's story or several fan theories.
Set the minimum increase, out of 100 new viewers, in those who want a ticket compared with today's campaign before allocating GBP 18 million.
reviews.naturalAnswer: At least 10 additional new viewers out of 100 must say they want a ticket compared with today's campaign before we move GBP 18 million.
